finding.title: Replace hardcoded English fallback strings in TutoredChildrenSection's error snackbars

evidence.quote:
AppLocalizations.of(context)?.tutoredEntryPermissionDenied ??
    'Access denied — the grant may have been revoked.',

AppLocalizations.of(context)?.tutoredEntryError ??
    'Could not load talmid data. Please try again.',

finding.why: Both snackbar messages fall back to raw, un-ARB'd English literals if AppLocalizations.of(context) returns null. That fallback would render untranslated on a Hebrew device in the (defensive-only) case it triggers. The same idiom exists at text_display_screen.dart:900 outside this batch, so it's a small but repeated pattern, not a one-off typo.
finding.recommendation: Drop the ?? fallback (AppLocalizations.of(context) is non-null under the app's own MaterialApp) or route the fallback through a second ARB key instead of an inline literal.
acceptance_criteria: The hardcoded-string audit grep is extended to catch this null-coalescing idiom

finding.title: Use PositionedDirectional in TutoredChildrenSection's pending-invite count badge instead of physical right:
finding.why: AX-1 bans physical left:/right: positioning in this RTL (Hebrew) app; EdgeInsets.only(left:/right:) and Alignment.centerLeft/Right are the named examples but Positioned(right:) is the same class of bug and isn't caught by the current grep (which only targets EdgeInsets/Alignment APIs) or by any of the 22 make audit checks (confirmed clean on this exact tree). In Hebrew/RTL the pending-invite count badge stays pinned to the physical right of the mail icon instead of mirroring to the leading/'start' corner like directional UI elsewhere in the app.
finding.recommendation: Wrap with PositionedDirectional(top: 6, end: 6, ...) — the Stack is already inside an ambient Directionality via MaterialApp.
acceptance_criteria: Positioned(...right:...) no longer appears in tutored_children_section.dart
The root Makefile's AX-1 grep is extended to also flag Positioned(...left:/right:...)

finding.title: Split hand-written Dart files over the 400-line cap in the profiles feature slice
finding.why: AG-3 caps hand-written Dart files at 400 lines; 6 of the 11 files in this batch exceed it, led by pin_flow_and_setup_dialog_l1_test.dart at 1575 lines (nearly 4x the cap) and tutored_children_section.dart at 672 lines. No existing checker enforces this — all 22 make audit checks are content-pattern greps, none count lines — so the cap has drifted silently.
finding.recommendation: Split the two largest files first: pin_flow_and_setup_dialog_l1_test.dart into per-source-file tests (fixes the AG-5 mirroring finding at the same time); tutored_children_section.dart by extracting _ViewInvitationsRow/_ManageGrantsRow/_TutoredChildRow to sibling files.
acceptance_criteria: A make target/CI step greps `find lib test -name '*.dart' | xargs wc -l` (excluding .g.dart/.freezed.dart) and fails on any file over 400 lines
All 6 listed files are at or under 400 lines

finding.title: Relocate profiles feature test files to their AG-5-mirrored paths

evidence.quote: (sits at presentation/ — mirrored path is presentation/widgets/profile_switcher_sheet_test.dart, which does not exist)

finding.why: AG-5 maps lib/a/b/foo.dart to test/a/b/foo_test.dart with only story_acceptance exempt. profile_switcher_sheet.dart's tests are split across profile_switcher_sheet_test.dart (one directory level shallow, missing /widgets/) and an2_switcher_pin_guard_test.dart (different name, same missing directory); the canonical mirrored path test/features/profiles/presentation/widgets/profile_switcher_sheet_test.dart does not exist at all (verified via directory listing). pin_flow_and_setup_dialog_l1_test.dart combines pin_flow_screen.dart (screens/), parent_pin_setup_dialog.dart (widgets/) and parent_pin_keypad_dialog.dart's change-dialog flow (widgets/ — which already has its own dedicated parent_pin_keypad_dialog_test.dart) at a non-mirrored top-level path. A contributor looking for 'where do I add a test for profile_switcher_sheet.dart' at the AG-5-mandated path finds nothing and risks adding a third, overlapping file.
finding.recommendation: Move profile_switcher_sheet_test.dart to presentation/widgets/, keep an2_switcher_pin_guard_test.dart alongside it (or fold in), and split pin_flow_and_setup_dialog_l1_test.dart's groups back onto pin_flow_screen_test.dart / parent_pin_setup_dialog_test.dart / parent_pin_keypad_dialog_test.dart.
acceptance_criteria: test/features/profiles/presentation/widgets/profile_switcher_sheet_test.dart exists and contains the sheet's tests
A script diffing lib/ and test/ trees (AG-5 checker) reports 0 unmirrored non-story_acceptance files for features/profiles/

finding.title: Replace DateTime.now() wall-clock calls with DateTimeFactory.nowUtc() in profile_creation_use_case_test.dart
finding.why: TQ-6 requires hermetic tests with no wall-clock; check 6/15 of make audit already forbids DateTime.now() in lib/ (outside core/time) but doesn't scan test/, so this slipped through. This same file's own setUp (line 37-38) correctly uses DateTimeFactory.nowUtc() — these 4 calls (lines 226, 227, 277, 278) are the only wall-clock use in the file, seeding LearnerProfilesCompanion.insert rows directly. Currently harmless since no assertion reads the timestamp, but it's an inconsistent, uncontrolled precedent in an otherwise clock-disciplined test file.
acceptance_criteria: The repo-wide DateTime.now() Rule-0 grep is extended to cover test/ (TQ-6 checker)
